exit 0
--- stdout
Mark a task as BLOCKED when work cannot proceed.
Per the blocking protocol (specs/architecture/roles.md), use this when:
- Spec ambiguity prevents implementation
- Missing external dependency blocks progress
- Design conflict discovered that requires rescoping
Requirements:
- Agent ID must be provided (via --agent-id flag or LIZA_AGENT_ID env var)
- Task must be in an executing status (e.g. IMPLEMENTING_CODE, CODE_PLANNING)
- Only the assigned agent can mark a task as blocked
- Requires a reason and 1-3 clarifying questions
Effects:
- status = BLOCKED
- blocked_reason = <reason>
- blocked_questions = [<questions>]
- repair_request = <structured orchestrator repair request> when --repair-* flags or --repair-request-file are provided
- With --human-action, the block is human-owned: an AWAITING HUMAN alert names the ask
- Clear assigned_to
- Clear lease_expires
- Add history entry with event "blocked"
- Triggers orchestrator wake
Usage:
liza mark-blocked <task-id> [flags]
Flags:
--agent-id string agent ID marking the task as blocked
--depends-on strings task IDs blocking this task; also used as the orchestrator re-wake signal
--expected-transition string current task transition_id captured before the request; requires --request-id
-h, --help help for mark-blocked
--human-action string one-line action only a human can take to clear this block, and how to signal it is done; raises AWAITING HUMAN
--json output result as structured JSON
--questions strings clarifying questions (1-3 required)
--reason string reason why the task is blocked (required)
--repair-command string exact command the orchestrator should run or adapt
--repair-evidence stringArray evidence gathered before requesting orchestrator repair
--repair-operation string orchestrator-only repair operation requested for this blocker
--repair-request-file string path to a complete JSON repair request; mutually exclusive with --repair-* fields
--repair-target string task or state object the requested repair should modify
--repair-validation stringArray validation already run or required after orchestrator repair
--request-id string logical request ID; preserve with its original --expected-transition across retries
--state-lock-timeout tag an infrastructure-only state-lock timeout for automatic continuation after a later successful publication
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
